scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the printed vector field for a nonzero and b,c positive. It excludes non-equilibrium compact recurrent statistical dynamics but not finite-time transients or unbounded trajectories. The full original article was not available in the inspected lawful public material; the exact vector field was independently checked in Rech's same-system paper, which explicitly attributes it to Yang and Liu.
title: A monotone radial law excludes recurrent chaos in the Yang–Liu cubic flow
